scope: ordinary uncultivated210 gems; ordered grade-unique list, at most three families and15 sockets; full original separate gem effects

designed.replacement: consume incoming one; replace existing same-grade gem in its position, no returned old gem; append if empty grade; validate resulting at-most-three family set
designed.binding: successful insertion equipment becomes bound if equipment or material bound; removal keeps equipment binding and returns all gems bound
designed.success: deterministic insertion/removal after all validations; cancellations never create domain plans or asset changes
designed.ordinary_return: grades1..6 use original removegem count and same template; grades7..15 use superremovegem count and original Diamondid one grade lower
designed.ordering: preserve explicit original imported order; same-grade replacement retains index; new grade appends; removal retains relative order
designed.unknown_flags: only explicit zero nonbinding flags supported; persistent authority must be supplied by owner, no inferred legacy zero
designed.score_and_color: not inferred from gem list; require separately versioned trusted score/color source before mutation integration
designed.activation: pure plans, native detail and explicit state storage are foundations; no shared activation or silent v1/v2 role projection of nonempty gems
